propositions: CodeQL workflow was changed from weekly schedule (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly schedule (35 */6 * * *) to restore coverage of newly-landed code
The 6-hourly cadence replaces the original push-on-main trigger that was removed in a prior change, reducing maximum exposure time for SAST findings from 7 days to 6 hours
Four 6-hourly branch-health lanes must use distinct off-the-hour minute offsets (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53, codeql.yml :35) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion
CodeQL cannot join the existing _SIX_HOURLY cohort because it has no push trigger, requiring a separate schedule-only cohort in the test policy
The outdated header comment asserting a 28x cost increase and deliberate exclusion from the 6-hourly tick was removed because navapbc/rebar is public and CodeQL/Actions minutes are free
